# Workflows

Default target: Local

## Targets

### Local

Author tracked TypeScript and validate with npm test. Run once with npm run workflow. No separate publish step. Inspect source and ignored run files. Definitions are tracked; SQLite and outputs are ignored. Credentials use environment variable pointers. Estimate provider cost before calls.

## Connections

### HubSpot

Uses HUBSPOT_TOKEN from the operator keychain. HubSpot API billing applies.

## Limits

Maximum 250 rows per run.
